scope: synthetic/code-contract only; no market-data fitting, untouched holdout access, strategy selection, or P&L

transition_prior.meaning: symmetric Dirichlet concentration parameter alpha per destination state for each transition-matrix row
transition_prior.not_meaning: not a transition probability, a multiplier on estimated probabilities, a prior on initial-state probabilities, or a regime count

transition_update.counts: N_ij = sum over adjacent training observations t of E[1(S_t=i,S_(t+1)=j) | X_train, y_train, current parameters], as computed by the forward-backward E-step
transition_update.prior: Each row of the K by K transition matrix independently receives Dirichlet(alpha,...,alpha), where alpha equals transition_prior.
transition_update.estimator: P_ij = (N_ij + alpha) / (sum over destinations j of N_ij + K * alpha)
transition_update.implementation_correspondence: Add alpha to every expected transition-count cell, then normalize each row.
transition_update.initial_state_prior: This contract does not apply transition_prior to initial-state probabilities; their update is separate.

required_synthetic_proofs: accept only n_regimes in {2,3} and transition_prior in {2,5}
transition rows sum to one for either regime count
changing alpha on the same deterministic synthetic training fixture changes the fitted transition matrix
final filtered terminal posterior is recomputed from the final stored parameters
reported log likelihood equals the final forward recursion terminal log normalizer
